messages:
sarah: Folks — need to swap my oncall shift Sat 16:00-00:00 PST. Unexpected family thing. Can anyone take it? I can do Sun 06:00-14:00 in exchange. Will prewarm everything.

dan: I can pick up Sat but prefer to split it — happy to take 20:00-00:00 if someone else can cover 16:00-20:00. @sarah is the Sun 06:00-14:00 trade ok for you?

sarah: Yep Sun slot works. Quick FYI — there's a scheduled DB index rollout Sat 18:00 for traffic shaping (infra says should be non-blocking for inference), so whoever takes Sat pls watch the DB rollout thread. I'll leave runbook notes below.

sarah: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall. Prewarm command I use before the shift: ```./scripts/prewarm.sh --models=chat-3,embed-vision --timeout=300``` Check metrics: /dashboards/oncall/latency?range=1h. If canary fails, fall back to chat-2-quant.

leah: I can cover Sat 16:00-20:00 and shadow after 20:00 for the first hour — have a meeting 21:00-22:00 though. If Dan takes 20:00-00:00 that splits nicely.

dan: Split sounds good to me. I'll take 20:00-00:00. @rotations-bot can you update the rota to reflect Leah 16-20, Dan 20-00, Sarah -> Sun 06-14? Mark as swap with reason: family.

rotations-bot: Rotation updated: Dan assigned 20:00-00:00 Sat, Leah 16:00-20:00 Sat, Sarah released for Sat and assigned Sun 06:00-14:00. Reminder: confirm runbook handoff in thread.

mike: Quick ops note: there's a cluster autoscaler test Sat 17:30-18:00 — expect transient node churn. If you see OOM on g5x2, try restarting the pod with env override: `MAX_MEMORY=4Gi`. Also double-check tail latency after autoscaler test.

tara: Thanks — @leah @dan please verify you can access KMS-staging keys and the customer key policy. Last week one of the shadows couldn't rotate keys.

anna: I'm happy to be secondary fallback 20:00-00:00 if something pops. Ping me on pager with priority=high if latency > 600ms or error rate > 2%.

leah: Confirmed I have KMS access and can run the prewarm. I'll take the first 15m to warm caches and verify routes. Will DM @sarah for the prewarm token.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Checklist I'm leaving in DM: 1) run prewarm script, 2) confirm model versions pinned (chat-3@v1.2.0), 3) validate canary traffic route, 4) watch DB rollout slack thread. If anything unexpected, escalate to #eng-sre and ping oncall pager. :heart:

dan: All set on my side. I've added a one-paragraph note to my handoff doc and synced the calendar. Thanks for covering.

rotations-bot: Thread summary: Sat coverage split confirmed — Leah 16:00-20:00, Dan 20:00-00:00. Sarah moved to Sun 06:00-14:00. Rota updated and handoff checklist posted. If escalation needed, use #eng-sre.
